name: GrassBendEmitter
src_typeComment: Drop this on a character/object walking through grass — it publishes its own position into a GLOBAL array every GrassWind-shaded renderer in the scene reads (see GrassInclude.cginc), so any number of grass patches react with zero per-patch wiring. This is a deliberate divergence from RippleEmitter's per-renderer MaterialPropertyBlock approach: a ripple emitter lives ON the one surface it affects, but a grass field is typically many separate renderers and the walker is a DIFFERENT object from all of them — a global array is what lets one emitter affect every patch in the level at once.

src_serialized.name: bendRadius
src_serialized.tooltip: How far from this object grass starts bending away.

src_serialized.name: bendStrength
src_serialized.tooltip: Peak horizontal push a blade standing right at this object gets. Combined across every active emitter by taking the LARGEST value among them — see the class comment on Publish().

src_members.name: Publish
src_members.comment: Public — not gated behind Update() — so a self-test can drive this deterministically without waiting on a real frame, same reasoning as every other "public Tick-equivalent" in this toolkit.

src_members.name: ActiveEmitterCountForTest
src_members.comment: Test-only accessors — reading GLOBAL shader state back isn't otherwise observable from a script in a way a self-test can assert against.
